attchmntText: Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Aarey Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited approved standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The board met on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations was 2,865.24 lakhs for the quarter. Profit for the period was 137.01 lakhs. Basic earnings per share was 0.43 rupees. For the half year, revenue was 13,324.99 lakhs. Half year profit was 239.38 lakhs. Basic EPS was 0.75 rupees. Total assets stood at 31,460.10 lakhs. The company purchased fixed assets not yet ready for use. No depreciation was charged on these assets. Trading window opens 48 hours after announcement.
